findings.detail: PR creation involves multiple steps (create issue, create PR, add assignees, push ref, sync divergence) in a transaction, but git push is outside the DB transaction
findings.recommendation: Git push failure after DB commit leaves orphaned PR record; add cleanup on push failure

non_atomic_operations: Git push to base repo ref happens after DB transaction commits; failure leaves PR in DB without git ref
endpoint_resiliency.cascading_failure_risk: Git repo unavailability would cause PR creation to fail with 500
endpoint_resiliency.graceful_degradation: Cleanup removes git ref on failure (best-effort)

findings.detail: Multiple mutations (title, body, deadline, assignees, milestone, labels, state, base) are not wrapped in a single transaction
findings.recommendation: Wrap all mutations in db.WithTx to prevent partial updates

non_atomic_operations: Sequential field updates without transaction: title change succeeds but label change fails leaves partial state

findings.detail: Merge operation uses global lock and checks HasMerged before proceeding; safe against double-merge

endpoint_resiliency.cascading_failure_risk: Git repo unavailability blocks all merges
endpoint_resiliency.graceful_degradation: Returns appropriate error codes for each failure mode

findings.detail: Uses global lock; checks divergence before update (returns error if already up to date)

endpoint_resiliency.graceful_degradation: Returns conflict error on merge/rebase failure

findings.detail: Checks if auto-merge exists before deleting; returns 404 if not found

rate_limiting.detail: No per-endpoint rate limiting on API
rate_limiting.recommendation: Add rate limiting for write endpoints like merge

single_points_of_failure: Git repository storage (local filesystem or NFS)
cascading_failure_paths: Git storage down → all PR create/merge/update/commits/files endpoints fail
